responsibility: Defines the fixed OpenBSD ABI mappings GCC uses to generate <stdint.h>. It specifies the exact-width, least-width, fast-width, max-width, pointer-sized, and sig_atomic_t type spellings expected by OpenBSD, with long-based intptr_t/uintptr_t and long long for 64-bit integer types. Its responsibility is limited to OpenBSD stdint type modeling.
